stories.stat_label: wild baby for a rescued orphan
stories.headline: A gorilla rescued from traffickers has her first wild baby
stories.summary: Lulingu was rescued at 18 months old and raised at the GRACE sanctuary. Released on Mount Tshiaberimu in 2024, she joined a wild silverback's group and gave birth in May.
stories.why: The tiny group there was at risk of dying out without new breeding females.

stories.headline: Norway's biggest Viking hoard just passed 5,000 coins
stories.summary: Detectorists found the Mørstad hoard in April with the landowner. The count has now reached about 5,200, and four coins of King Harald Hardrada date the burial to around 1046.
stories.why: It's Norway's largest Viking coin find, and more coins are still turning up.

stories.stat_label: years since it was last recorded
stories.headline: A tiny fish unseen in Sri Lanka since 1936 is back
stories.summary: Researchers found yellow-stripe gobies, just 14 to 19 mm long, in a tidal pool on Karaitivu Island near Jaffna, an area left unsurveyed for decades during the civil war.
stories.why: It shows long-unstudied places can still hide species we thought we'd lost.

stories.stat_label: γ-iron found in natural Moon soil
stories.headline: Moon soil from the far side holds a 'magnetic fossil'
stories.summary: Scientists studying Chang'e-6 samples found nanoscale γ-iron, a magnetic form of iron never before seen in natural lunar samples, holding a stable magnetic 'vortex'.
stories.why: It could help reveal the history of the Moon's long-lost magnetic field.

fun_fact: Grauer's gorillas live only in eastern DR Congo and are critically endangered.
